title: South Korea sets up team for Lee-Trump golf outing

blocks.text: Seoul’s presidential office has assembled a working-level team to prepare for a possible golf outing between President Lee Jae Myung and US President Donald Trump. The preparations followed Trump’s repeated expressions of interest in playing golf with Lee, most recently during their September meeting in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.
